summary: Complete the 3D mass-property update module and collider pose propagation; share body/integer/pose replay infrastructure and record the user-approved initial completion scope.
regressions: Anisotropic, singular and zero inverse inertia, nonidentity inertia reference frames, static/locked mass axes and offset COMs
Collider parent gathers with multiple colliders per body, multi-batch interleaving, 63/64/65 boundaries, empty and zero-batch dispatches
Exact copied masses, homogeneous matrix constants, explicit padding, readonly inputs and inactive sentinels
Malformed parent indices, poses, dimensions, layouts, negative principal inverse inertia and truncated outputs are rejected
Body, pose and original Coulomb handoff return comparators exercised separately
differences: No Rust production arithmetic or existing floating tolerance changed. The shader tree mirrors mprops_update.rs and body.rs; shared quaternion primitives follow pinned glam expressions.
As with previous ports, full-count launches specialize Rust grid-stride loops; world mass update and collider propagation remain separate operations.
The user explicitly deferred articulated multibodies in addition to MPM and 2D. Deferred inventory entries remain unported and visible but no longer block completion of the agreed 3D scope.
The existing zero-distance numerical discrepancy remains under investigation using physical/stability evidence, as the user accepts finite-precision differences. It is not hidden by this change.
